findings.title: Unverified funding offers remain too high in secondary matches
findings.observed: Tech and Sun check group ranks Volta Capital #4 at65 despite an overview-only record, Mexican energy-investment focus and no verified philanthropic grant offer.
findings.impact: Research time can be spent on an organization without an applicable verified funding program. It is not shown as a lead, which limits the harm.
findings.recommendation: Place overview-only records without a verified funding offer behind verified programs in a separate research/resource tier. Retain the record and thematic score; do not invent grant terms or an exhaustive geographic exclusion.

findings.title: Mandatory applicant and beneficiary conditions need structured coverage
findings.observed: Verizon is #3 at65 in Tech and Sun secondary matches with Invitation or partner route. Its official rules require an eligible IRS public charity or eligible NCES-registered school; education grants target K–12. Tech and Sun is described as an NGO serving university students/builders, with registration unconfirmed.
findings.impact: Invitation status alone is not the main suitability question. Details contain some rules, but the readiness badge does not establish the required applicant or target population.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit self-reported public-charity/school and program-specific beneficiary checks. Keep unconfirmed facts unknown; Nigeria work alone is not a country exclusion.

findings.title: Failed-prerequisite copy uses an ambiguous score label
findings.observed: ERA MIT Solve displays85/100 thematic fit alongside Known prerequisite conflict: score held at zero. The zero is research priority, not thematic fit.
findings.recommendation: Replace score held at zero with Research priority is0; thematic fit is unchanged.

findings.title: Actionable grant leads are thin
findings.observed: Omo Yoruba, Green Goods and ERA have one lead each; Tech and Sun has zero with grant/prize preferences. Relationship-only partners and speculative funding types dominate the secondary list.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize new officially documented California culture, open-source public goods, Nigeria community-energy/connectivity and ecosystem-restoration calls.
